voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack - Deep Dark Horror Narrator (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: December, eighteen twenty. Tennessee. They are burying John Bell.
lines.beat_before: hook: the funeral at dusk in snow; the camera tracks behind mourners with lanterns; the coffin is lowered on ropes

lines.text: Witnesses said a voice laughed over the grave. And sang. Until the last mourner left.
lines.beat_before: a laugh from nowhere; a gust rips across the graveyard; the lanterns go out one after another down the line; every mourner turns to look past the camera

lines.text: The morning he died, the family found a small vial no one recognised.
lines.beat_before: REWIND (the tape runs backwards); December 1820, the sickroom: the camera creeps from the door towards the bed

lines.text: The voice said it had given him a dose.
lines.beat_before: on the windowsill a small vial rolls by itself towards the bed; the hand on the quilt twitches; the candle leans away

lines.text: For three years, it had talked. Visitors said it repeated sermons, word for word.
lines.beat_before: REWIND; 1819, the main room: the family at supper, the camera circling the table

lines.text: It pulled the covers off the children's beds. Every night.
lines.beat_before: every candle flame leans towards the empty chair; it scrapes back; on the wall, the shadow of someone sitting in it; REWIND

lines.text: It began in eighteen seventeen. With scratching. On the outside of the walls.
lines.beat_before: 1818, the children's room: from the doorway, a quilt slides off a bed, then is yanked to the floor; REWIND

lines.text: Almost all of this comes from one book, written seventy years later. The family's own account has never been found.
lines.beat_before: 1817, outside at night: tracking along the log wall, scratches appear on the logs ahead of the camera; something moves through the corn towards the house

lines.text: This is the first night. You know how it ends.
lines.beat_before: the first night inside: candlelight on a bedpost; one scratch draws itself into the wood
